title: Lost Mary Nera15K Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry flavour Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod delivers a trio of red fruits in one vivid flavour. Sweet Strawberry provides a smooth base, while tangy Raspberry adds a bright tang and juicy Cherry rounds off the mix with its rich, silky sweetness. Together, they create a lively fruit blend that’s a pleasure to enjoy throughout the day and beyond. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. This system provides up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage and removes the need for messy refills or coil changes. Fitted with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod produces consistent vapour and full-bodied flavour from start to finish. Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to go. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
